parsed.notes: Complete and correct. Characterization (1) proved both directions; erasure lemma proved for all terms by induction (constructs m=Rp^k with same small-prime support, m<x, m≥A); σ(m) membership criterion then gives global periodicity from threshold A, not merely eventual; T counted per length-L window; a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n≥1.
